description: This PHP source file defines a class ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber that listens to kernel request events in a Symfony-based PHP application. It checks if requested modules are disabled, and if so, it either forwards the request to a handler or throws a forbidden exception. The class utilizes dependency injection and traits for utility functions.

classes.name: ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that intercepts request events to prevent access to disabled modules by forwarding or forbidding requests.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ModuleService, creating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the events this subscriber listens to; in this case, the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming request events; checks if the requested path targets disabled modules and throws exceptions accordingly.
